name: kaleta
description: Runbooks for Kaleta CMS sites over the site's own Claude connection (MCP): move a WordPress or any other site, launch a fresh install, weekly care, online bookings and an EU compliance check. Drafts first; the site owner publishes.

mcp_url.title: Kaleta site connection address
mcp_url.description: Claude Code only: the address your Kaleta administration shows for connecting Claude, e.g. https://www.example.com/mcp (a site in a subfolder: https://www.example.com/web/mcp). You sign in on the site when Claude Code connects; no password or token goes here. In claude.ai, the desktop app and Cowork add the site as a custom connector instead.
